# LLM & Agent Authoring Guide (`three-live` & `xr-live`)

This guide is designed for **LLMs, coding assistants, and autonomous agents**
generating 3D and Spatial Computing (AR/VR/XR) code with `<three-live>` and
`<xr-live>`.

- **Repository Agent Instructions:** [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)
- **Installable Agent Skills:**
  - [`skills/three-live-authoring/SKILL.md`](../skills/three-live-authoring/SKILL.md) (building 3D/XR scenes and apps)
  - [`skills/xr-live-plugin-dev/SKILL.md`](../skills/xr-live-plugin-dev/SKILL.md) (contributing cross-platform traits and plugins)
- **Single-File Context Feeds:** [`/llms.txt`](../llms.txt) (concise index) and [`/llms-full.txt`](../llms-full.txt) (complete reference)

You can copy the **System Prompt Snippet** below directly into any LLM prompt or
agent skill to guarantee valid, zero-hallucination output.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Copy-Paste System Prompt Snippet for LLMs

```markdown
You are authoring 3D and Spatial Computing scenes using Google's `three-live` and `xr-live` web components.

### 1. Choose the Right Component & Bundle
- Use `<three-live>` (`three-live.min.js` or `three-live-full.min.js`) for 3D product viewers, procedural Three.js scenes, `KHR_interactivity` behavior graphs, PBR Next materials, and 1-tap mobile AR handoff (Quick Look / Scene Viewer / WebXR).
- Use `<xr-live>` (`xr-live.min.js` or `xr-live-full.min.js`) when the scene requires interactive 6DoF WebXR, declarative spatial traits (`userData.xr`), spatial HTML cards (`<div slot="spatial">`), depth occlusion & physics (`xr-depth`), 25-joint hand tracking (`xr-hands`), or any of the 14 spatial plugins (`head-follow`, `manipulation-handles`, `world-understanding`, `gemini-live`, `spatial-paint`, `depth-particles`, `splat-loader`, `spatial-measure`, `magnetic-snap`, `gaze-dwell`, `exploded-view`, `persistent-anchors`, `spatial-locomotion`, `shared-room`).

### 2. Procedural `<script type="text/three">` Rules
- Inside `<script type="text/three">`, the globals `THREE` and `scene` (a `THREE.Scene` instance) are pre-defined.
- ALWAYS add the `allow-client-scripts` attribute to any `<three-live>` or `<xr-live>` element that contains an inline `<script type="text/three">`; without it the script is refused and nothing renders.
- Add all meshes, groups, and lights directly to `scene.add(...)`, and give interactive meshes a unique `mesh.name = '...'`.
- Attach canonical spatial traits via `mesh.userData.xr = { ... }`:
  - `grab`: `'1-hand' | '2-hand' | true`
  - `scale`: `{ min: 0.1, max: 5.0 } | true`
  - `billboard`: `'capsule' | 'cylindrical' | 'spherical' | true`
  - `follow`: `'head' | 'hand-left' | 'hand-right'` or `{ mode: 'head', lazy: true, distance: 1.2, deadzoneDeg: 15, stiffness: 6, height: -0.1, faceUser: true }`
  - `anchor`: `'floor' | 'wall' | 'ceiling' | 'table' | 'horizontal' | 'vertical'` or `{ target: 'table', id: 'part-1', persist: true }`
  - `physics`: `'dynamic' | 'static'` (optional `restitution: 0.7`)
  - `orbit`: `{ target: [x, y, z] | 'nodeName', radius: 0.5, speed: 0.8, height: 0, faceCenter: true }`
  - `handles`: `{ rotateAxis: 'y' | 'none', minScale: 0.2, maxScale: 3.0 } | true`
  - `dimensions`: `{ unit: 'auto' | 'm' | 'cm' | 'mm' | 'in' | 'ft-in', axes: ['x', 'y', 'z'], color: '#38bdf8', showOnSelect: false } | true`
  - `snapTo`: `{ grid: 0.05, angleDeg: 15, surface: 'floor' | 'wall' | 'ceiling' | 'any' | 'none', socketTag: 'dock', radius: 0.15 } | true`
  - `snapSocket`: `'dock'` or `{ tag: 'dock', radius: 0.15, alignRotation: true, highlightColor: '#22c55e' }`
  - `gaze`: `{ dwellMs: 1200, action: 'select' | 'ask', repeat: false } | true`
  - `explode`: `{ direction: [0, 1, 0], distance: 0.35, layer: 1, leaderLine: true } | boolean`
  - `navigable`: `true | 'walkable' | 'blocked'`
  - `sync`: `boolean` (multi-user `shared-room` transform sync; defaults to `true` on grabbable nodes)
  - `particles`: `{ preset: 'rain' | 'snow' | 'sparks' | 'confetti', count: 400, area: [2, 2, 2], speed: 1.0 }`
  - `holdToAsk`: `{ prompt: 'What is this?', holdMs: 600 } | true`
  - `worldUnderstanding`: `{ planes: true, meshes: false, reticle: true }`
  - `splatUrl`: `'https://.../capture.spz'` (or `.splat`)
  - `audio`: `{ src: 'https://.../sound.mp3', refDistance: 1.0, loop: false }`
- Attach declarative `KHR_interactivity` behaviors via `mesh.userData.interactivity = { onSelect: [...], onHoverIn: [...], onStart: [...] }` using actions `toggleTransform`, `interpolate`, `setProperty`, `toggleVisibility`, `cycleMaterialColor`, `playAnimation`, `stopAnimation`, or `sendEvent`.
- NEVER use `GLTFLoader`, `OBJLoader`, `TextureLoader`, `EffectComposer`, `ShaderMaterial`, `RawShaderMaterial`, or `requestAnimationFrame` inside `<script type="text/three">`.
- NEVER create a `THREE.WebGLRenderer` or attach DOM canvas elements inside `<script type="text/three">`.
- Respect strict scene quotas: max 1,000 meshes, 100,000 vertices, 300,000 indices, 16 textures, 3-second execution timeout.

### 3. Allowed `THREE.*` Constructors inside `<script type="text/three">`
- Math: `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Euler`, `Quaternion`, `Matrix3`, `Matrix4`, `Color`, `MathUtils`, `Clock`
- Geometries: `BoxGeometry`, `PlaneGeometry`, `SphereGeometry`, `CylinderGeometry`, `ConeGeometry`, `TorusGeometry`, `TorusKnotGeometry`, `BufferGeometry`, `BufferAttribute`
- Materials: `MeshStandardMaterial`, `MeshBasicMaterial`, `MeshLambertMaterial`, `MeshPhongMaterial`, `MeshPhysicalMaterial`
- Scene Graph: `Scene`, `Group`, `Mesh`, `Object3D` (`position`, `rotation`, `scale`, `matrix`, `add`, `remove`, `traverse`)
- Lights & Cameras: `AmbientLight`, `DirectionalLight`, `PointLight`, `Camera`, `PerspectiveCamera`
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DO vs. DO NOT Cheat Sheet

| DO (Supported & Fast) | DO NOT (Unsupported / Anti-Pattern) |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Use `new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, metalness, roughness })` | Do NOT use `THREE.ShaderMaterial` or custom GLSL strings in scripts |
| Add objects to the global `scene` (`scene.add(mesh)`) | Do NOT instantiate `new THREE.WebGLRenderer()` or call `renderer.render()` |
| Set `mesh.userData.xr = { grab: '2-hand', handles: { rotateAxis: 'y' } }` | Do NOT write manual WebXR session setup (`navigator.xr.requestSession`) |
| Set `mesh.userData.interactivity = { onSelect: [{ action: 'toggleTransform', ... }] }` | Do NOT try to access `window` or `document` inside sandboxed `<script type="text/three">` |
| Use `<div slot="spatial" data-position="x y z" data-xr-traits="grab billboard">` for spatial HTML UI | Do NOT use `new THREE.GLTFLoader().load(...)` inside procedural scripts (use `src="..."` or `<xr-anchor src="...">`) |

### Permissive Fallback Shims & Diagnostic Warnings (JS & Rust Compiler)

While LLMs should prefer the canonical APIs above for highest fidelity, both the
JavaScript authoring runtime (`three-author`) and the native Rust compiler
(`compiler/`) include **permissive fallback shims** so common LLM-generated
Three.js assumptions never crash or abort a 3D/XR scene:

-   **Shaders (`ShaderMaterial`, `RawShaderMaterial`):** Gracefully downgraded
    to `MeshStandardMaterial`, preserving `uniforms.color.value` /
    `params.color` and opacity so the mesh renders in 3D and XR.
-   **Polyhedra & Extended Geometries (`IcosahedronGeometry`,
    `OctahedronGeometry`, `DodecahedronGeometry`, `TetrahedronGeometry`,
    `CapsuleGeometry`, `RingGeometry`, `CircleGeometry`):** Mapped to
    parameter-compatible `SphereGeometry` or `CylinderGeometry` primitives.
-   **Lights (`SpotLight`, `HemisphereLight`, `RectAreaLight`):** Mapped to
    `PointLight` or `AmbientLight`.
-   **Unknown / Hallucinated Classes:** Any unknown `THREE.*` class resolves to
    a safe recursive no-op proxy, and `new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)` automatically
    substitutes a fallback `BoxGeometry` / `MeshStandardMaterial` if passed a
    non-geometry or non-material proxy.
-   **Browser Boilerplate (`requestAnimationFrame`, `window`, `document`):**
    Safely shimmed in headless/Worker/Rust sandboxes so trailing render loops
    (`requestAnimationFrame(animate)`) or `window.innerWidth /
    window.innerHeight` checks do not throw `ReferenceError`.
-   **Diagnostic Warnings:** Every degraded feature logs a deduplicated
    `console.warn` and is recorded in `THREE.getAuthorWarnings()` (reset via
    `THREE.clearAuthorWarnings()`).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Canonical Few-Shot Templates

### Template 1: Interactive 3D Scene with `KHR_interactivity` & AR Handoff (`<three-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live-full.min.js"></script>

<three-live allow-client-scripts camera-controls ar auto-rotate shadow-intensity="0.7" style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const base = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6, 0.7, 0.2, 32),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x1e293b, metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.2 })
    );
    base.name = 'pedestal';
    scene.add(base);

    const crystal = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.35, 32, 32),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.1 })
    );
    crystal.name = 'crystal';
    crystal.position.set(0, 0.55, 0);
    crystal.userData.interactivity = {
      onSelect: [
        { action: 'toggleTransform', property: 'translation', from: [0, 0.55, 0], to: [0, 0.85, 0], duration: 0.35 },
        { action: 'cycleMaterialColor', colors: [[0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 1], [0.66, 0.33, 0.97, 1]], duration: 0.25 }
      ]
    };
    scene.add(crystal);

    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0);
    light.position.set(2, 4, 3);
    scene.add(light);
  </script>
</three-live>
```

### Template 2: Full Spatial Computing Scene with Extended XR Traits (`<xr-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  xr-mode="ar"
  xr-depth="occlusion-physics"
  xr-hands="gestures"
  xr-simulator="living-room"
  world-understanding="planes reticle"
  spatial-paint="#38bdf8"
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 600px; display: block;">

  <!-- Interactive procedural 3D objects with canonical userData.xr traits -->
  <script type="text/three">
    const sculpture = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.18, 0.06, 64, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xa855f7, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.25 })
    );
    sculpture.name = 'sculpture';
    sculpture.position.set(0, 1.1, -1.0);
    sculpture.userData.xr = {
      grab: '2-hand',
      handles: { rotateAxis: 'y', minScale: 0.3, maxScale: 3.0 },
      holdToAsk: { prompt: 'What is this sculpture?', holdMs: 600 }
    };
    scene.add(sculpture);

    const satellite = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.05, 24, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8 })
    );
    satellite.name = 'satellite';
    satellite.userData.xr = {
      orbit: { target: 'sculpture', radius: 0.38, speed: 1.0, faceCenter: true }
    };
    scene.add(satellite);
  </script>

  <!-- Live HTML spatial card floating next to the 3D object -->
  <div slot="spatial" data-position="0.45 1.1 -1.0" data-xr-traits="grab billboard">
    <div style="padding: 14px; background: #111827; color: #f9fafb; border-radius: 12px; width: 220px;">
      <h4>Spatial Control Panel</h4>
      <p>Drag corner handles to scale, or pinch in empty space to paint in 3D.</p>
      <button onclick="console.log('Clicked in 3D space!')">Inspect Details</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</xr-live>
```

### Template 3: Collaborative CAD Studio (`exploded-view` + `spatial-measure` + `magnetic-snap` + `shared-room`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  spatial-measure="all"
  measure-unit="cm"
  magnetic-snap="all"
  gaze-dwell="auto"
  explode="0.4"
  explode-mode="axial-y"
  section-plane="x:0"
  persistent-anchors="cad-review"
  persist-url-hash
  locomotion="teleport snap-turn"
  shared-room="cad-review-room"
  peer-name="Reviewer"
  peer-color="#38bdf8"
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 600px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const deck = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.4, 1.4, 0.04, 48),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0f172a, roughness: 0.85 })
    );
    deck.name = 'walkable-deck';
    deck.position.set(0, -0.45, -1.2);
    deck.userData.xr = { navigable: 'walkable', explode: false, sync: false };
    scene.add(deck);

    const chassis = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.32, 0.16, 36),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x334155, metalness: 0.75, roughness: 0.25 })
    );
    chassis.name = 'turbine-chassis';
    chassis.position.set(0, 0.75, -1.2);
    chassis.userData.xr = {
      dimensions: { unit: 'cm', axes: ['x', 'y', 'z'] },
      snapSocket: { tag: 'rotor-bay', radius: 0.18, highlightColor: '#22c55e' },
      explode: false
    };
    scene.add(chassis);

    const shroud = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.26, 0.22, 36),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8, metalness: 0.65, roughness: 0.2 })
    );
    shroud.name = 'upper-shroud';
    shroud.position.set(0, 0.96, -1.2);
    shroud.userData.xr = {
      grab: '1-hand',
      snapTo: { socketTag: 'rotor-bay', radius: 0.18, angleDeg: 15 },
      explode: { direction: [0, 1, 0], distance: 0.32, layer: 2, leaderLine: true },
      gaze: { dwellMs: 1000, action: 'select' },
      anchor: { id: 'upper-shroud', persist: true },
      sync: true
    };
    scene.add(shroud);

    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.2);
    key.position.set(2, 4, 3);
    scene.add(key);
    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6));
  </script>
</xr-live>
```

# `<three-live>` & `<xr-live>` Complete Traits, Plugins & Events Reference

## 1. `<xr-live>` Host Attributes

`<xr-live>` inherits every `<three-live>` attribute (`src`, `ios-src`, `poster`, `scale`, `camera-orbit`, `camera-target`, `min-camera-orbit`, `max-camera-orbit`, `field-of-view`, `selected-mesh`, `camera-controls`, `ar`, `ar-modes`, `ar-scale`, `ar-placement`, `script-src`, `sandbox`, `allow-client-scripts`, `exposure`, `environment-image`, `skybox-image`, `shadow-intensity`, `shadow-softness`, `tone-mapping`, `autoplay`, `animation-name`, `auto-rotate`) and adds:

| Attribute | Values | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `xr-mode` | `'ar' \| 'vr' \| 'inline' \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Target WebXR session mode. |
| `xr-depth` | `'occlusion' \| 'occlusion-physics' \| 'mesh' \| 'none'` | `'none'` | Hardware depth occlusion and analytical heightfield physics collision. |
| `xr-hands` | `'gestures' \| 'joints' \| 'pinch' \| 'none'` | `'none'` | 25-joint `XRHand` tracking and gesture classification (`pinch`, `grab`, `point`, `palm-up`). |
| `xr-simulator` | `'living-room' \| 'office' \| 'tabletop' \| 'none'` | `'none'` | Enables the desktop 6DoF keyboard/mouse simulator with room floor/table planes. |
| `xr-profile` | `'quest3' \| 'android-xr' \| 'visionos' \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Target hardware profile hint. |
| `sound-feedback` | boolean attribute | `false` | Plays procedural Web Audio earcons (`grab`, `release`, `bounce`, `hover`) on interaction. |
| `world-understanding` | `'' \| 'planes' \| 'planes reticle' \| 'false'` | — | Activates `xr-live-world-understanding` plane/mesh tracking and optional gaze reticle. |
| `spatial-paint` | `'' \| '#rrggbb' \| 'false'` | — | Activates `xr-live-spatial-paint`; pinching in empty space extrudes Catmull-Rom 3D tube strokes. |
| `spatial-measure` | `'' \| 'bounds' \| 'tape' \| 'all' \| 'none'` | — | Activates `xr-live-spatial-measure` 3D dimension callouts and/or interactive AR tape measure. |
| `measure-unit` | `'auto' \| 'm' \| 'cm' \| 'mm' \| 'in' \| 'ft-in'` | `'auto'` | Default display unit for `spatial-measure`. |
| `magnetic-snap` | `'' \| 'grid' \| 'surface' \| 'sockets' \| 'all' \| 'none'` | — | Activates `xr-live-magnetic-snap` socket, grid, surface, and yaw snapping. |
| `snap-grid` | `number` or `'gx gy gz'` (meters) | — | Default Cartesian snap grid spacing in meters. |
| `snap-angle` | `number` (`0..180` degrees) | `0` | Default rotational yaw snap increment in degrees. |
| `gaze-dwell` | `'' \| 'auto' \| 'false' \| 'none'` | — | Activates `xr-live-gaze-dwell` hands-free eye/head gaze reticle and radial dwell selection. |
| `dwell-time` | `number` (`250..10000` ms) | `1200` | Default dwell duration in milliseconds for `gaze-dwell`. |
| `explode` | `number` (`0..1`) | `0` | Normalized multi-part assembly explosion factor (`xr-live-exploded-view`). |
| `explode-mode` | `'radial' \| 'axial-x' \| 'axial-y' \| 'axial-z' \| 'hierarchical'` | `'radial'` | Automatic explosion vector strategy when parts omit `userData.xr.explode.direction`. |
| `explode-scale` | `number` | `1.0` | Multiplier applied to per-part explosion distances. |
| `section-plane` | `'none' \| 'x:<d>' \| 'y:<d>' \| 'z:<d>' \| '-x:<d>' \| '-y:<d>' \| '-z:<d>' \| 'interactive'` | `'none'` | Real-time GPU cross-section clipping plane in scene (model) space (`d` in meters; the cut follows the model through AR placement and turntable rotation) with optional draggable gizmo frame. |
| `persistent-anchors` | `''` or `string` (namespace) | — | Activates `xr-live-persistent-anchors` cross-session transform persistence (`xr-live:anchors:<ns>`). |
| `persist-url-hash` | boolean attribute | `false` | Encodes persisted node poses into `#xr-state=<base64url>` (`<= 8192` bytes) for link sharing. |
| `locomotion` | `'' \| 'teleport' \| 'snap-turn' \| 'smooth' \| 'teleport snap-turn' \| 'none'` | — | Activates `xr-live-spatial-locomotion` parabolic teleportation, snap-turns, or smooth glide. |
| `snap-turn-deg` | `number` (degrees) | `30` | Horizontal thumbstick snap-turn increment in degrees. |
| `comfort-vignette` | boolean attribute | `true` | Shows a `120ms` peripheral FOV comfort vignette during teleports and snap-turns. |
| `shared-room` | `'<room-id>'` or `'wss://...'` | — | Joins a multi-user room via `BroadcastChannel("xr-live:room:<id>")` or a `wss://` relay (`xr-live-shared-room`). |
| `peer-name` | `string` (max `32` chars) | — | Local peer display name broadcast in `shared-room`. |
| `peer-color` | `'#rrggbb'` | `'#38bdf8'` | Local peer 3D visor & laser ray tint color in `shared-room`. |
| `webmcp` | boolean attribute | `false` | Registers `inspect_xr_scene`, `place_xr_object_at_gaze`, and `capture_xr_view` on `navigator.modelContext`. |
| `webmcp-allow-depth` | boolean attribute | `false` | Opt-in gate allowing `capture_xr_view` to include the 8×8 metric `depthGridMeters` array. |
| `webmcp-omit-pose` | boolean attribute | `false` | When present, `inspect_xr_scene` omits `headPosition` entirely. |

## 3. Declarative `KHR_interactivity` Authoring (`userData.interactivity`)

Any mesh or group inside `<script type="text/three">` can declare interactive state machines compiled into standard Khronos `KHR_interactivity` graphs (`three-live/src/interactivity-compiler.ts`):

- **Triggers:**
  - `onSelect`: Fired when clicked/tapped or pinched in XR (`pointer/onSelect`).
  - `onHoverIn` / `onHoverOut`: Fired on pointer/ray hover enter and exit.
  - `onStart`: Fired automatically when the scene loads (`event/onStart`).
  - `onReceive`: `{ [eventName: string]: Action | Action[] }` — reacts to custom events sent by `sendEvent`.
- **Actions (single object or array executed in sequence):**
  - `{ action: 'toggleTransform', property: 'translation' | 'rotation' | 'scale', to: number[], from?: number[], duration?: number }`
  - `{ action: 'interpolate', target?: string, property: 'translation' | 'rotation' | 'scale' | 'baseColorFactor' | 'metallicFactor' | 'roughnessFactor' | 'emissiveFactor', to: number | number[], duration?: number }`
  - `{ action: 'setProperty', target?: string, property: string, value: any }`
  - `{ action: 'toggleVisibility', target?: string }`
  - `{ action: 'cycleMaterialColor', colors: Array<[number, number, number, number?]>, duration?: number }`
  - `{ action: 'playAnimation', animation?: number }` / `{ action: 'stopAnimation' }`
  - `{ action: 'sendEvent', event: string, values?: Record<string, any> }`

---

## 4. Programmatic Plugin Controllers (`xr-live/plugins`)

When importing from `xr-live/plugins` (or using `xr-live-plugins.min.js` / `xr-live-full.min.js`):

- **Gemini Live (`gemini-live.ts`):**
  ```ts
  import { connectGeminiLive } from 'xr-live/plugins';

  const live = connectGeminiLive(xrElement, {
    url: 'wss://your-backend.example.com/gemini-live', // wss:// required (or ws://localhost)
    model: 'models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp',
    systemInstruction: 'You are a spatial assistant.',
    frameIntervalMs: 1000,   // clamped to [250, 60000] ms
    streamAudio: true,       // streams 16 kHz PCM mic chunks
    playAudio: true,         // plays streamed 24 kHz PCM model audio
    speakReplies: false,     // SpeechSynthesis fallback
    detectObjects: true,     // auto-registers report_objects tool -> xr-object-detected events
  });
  ```
- **Spatial Paint (`spatial-paint.ts`):**
  ```ts
  import { getSpatialPaintController } from 'xr-live/plugins';

  const paint = getSpatialPaintController(xrElement);
  paint.color = [0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 1.0];
  paint.radius = 0.008;
  paint.undo(xrElement.viewer);
  paint.clear(xrElement.viewer);
  ```
- **World Understanding (`world-understanding.ts`):**
  ```ts
  import { detectObjects, parseDetections, XRTapeMeasure } from 'xr-live/plugins';

  const detections = parseDetections('[{"label":"chair","box":[200,300,800,700]}]');
  const located3D = detectObjects(xrElement, detections);
  ```
- **Spatial Measure, Exploded View, Persistent Anchors, Locomotion & Shared Room:**
  ```ts
  import {
    getSpatialMeasureController,
    getMagneticSnapController,
    getGazeDwellController,
    getExplodedViewController,
    getPersistentAnchorsController,
    getSpatialLocomotionController,
    getSharedRoomController,
  } from 'xr-live/plugins';

  xrElement.setExplode(0.65);                     // Smoothly animate exploded-view [0..1]
  xrElement.clearMeasurements();                  // Clear locked 3D tape-measure segments
  const token = xrElement.exportAnchorState();    // Base64url layout snapshot (<= 8 KB)
  xrElement.importAnchorState(token);             // Restore layout snapshot programmatically
  xrElement.teleportTo([0, 0, -1.5]);             // Teleport viewer rig + emit xrteleport
  const peers = xrElement.getSharedPeers();       // Active RemotePeerState[] in shared-room
  ```

---

## 5. DOM Events Summary

| Event Name | Dispatched By | `event.detail` Payload |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `load` | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ model: GLBData }` |
| `error` | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ error: Error }` |
| `meshclick` | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ meshName, hitPoint, normal, distance }` |
| `camera-change` | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ theta, phi, distance }` |
| `ar-status` | `<three-live>` / `<xr-live>` | `{ status: 'session-started' \| 'not-presenting' \| 'failed', error? }` |
| `interactivityEvent` | `KHR_interactivity` VM | `{ id: string, values: Record<string, any> }` |
| `xr-select-start` / `move` / `end` | `XRInputManager` | `{ hand: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'screen', pivotPosition, quaternion, rayOrigin, rayDirection, hit }` |
| `xr-handles-change` | `manipulation-handles` | `{ mesh, scale: number, yawDeg: number }` |
| `xr-object-detected` | `world-understanding` | `{ label: string, position: [number, number, number], distanceMeters: number, source: 'plane' \| 'depth' \| 'fallback' }` |
| `xr-transcription` | `gemini-live` | `{ speaker: 'user' \| 'model', text: string, isFinal: boolean }` |
| `xr-hold-to-ask-listening` | `gemini-live` | `{ mesh: string }` |
| `xr-hold-to-ask` | `gemini-live` | `{ mesh: string, transcript: string, prompt: string }` |
| `xr-gemini-interrupted` | `gemini-live` | `{}` |
| `xr-paint-stroke` | `spatial-paint` | `{ index: number, points: number, lengthMeters: number }` |
| `measurecomplete` | `spatial-measure` | `{ start: [x,y,z], end: [x,y,z], distanceMeters: number, formatted: string }` |
| `xrsnap` | `magnetic-snap` | `{ node, socket, position: [x,y,z], quaternion: [x,y,z,w], mode: 'socket' \| 'grid' \| 'surface' \| 'angle' }` |
| `xrunsnap` | `magnetic-snap` | `{ node, socket }` |
| `gazeenter` / `gazeleave` | `gaze-dwell` | `{ node, point: [x,y,z] }` / `{ node }` |
| `gazedwell` | `gaze-dwell` | `{ node, point: [x,y,z], action: 'select' \| 'ask' }` |
| `explodechange` | `exploded-view` | `{ factor: number, source: 'attribute' \| 'gesture' \| 'api' \| 'peer' }` |
| `anchorsrestored` | `persistent-anchors` | `{ count: number, source: 'xr-anchor' \| 'storage' \| 'url-hash' }` |
| `xrteleport` | `spatial-locomotion` | `{ from: [x,y,z], to: [x,y,z], yawDeg: number }` |
| `peerjoin` / `peerleave` | `shared-room` | `{ peerId: string, name: string, color: string }` |
| `peergrabconflict` | `shared-room` | `{ peerId: string, nodeId: string }` |
| `peersync` | `shared-room` | `{ peerId: string, nodeId: string }` |
| `xr-webmcp-capture` | `xr-extras` (WebMCP) | Fired when `capture_xr_view` captures a frame (`data-xr-webmcp-indicator="active"`). |

# Copy-Paste Recipes for `<three-live>` and `<xr-live>`

All 9 recipes below use features available in the repository today and work without external build steps.

## Recipe 2: Spatial UI Card & Depth-Physics Ballpit (`<xr-live>`)

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  xr-mode="ar"
  xr-depth="occlusion-physics"
  xr-hands="gestures"
  xr-simulator="living-room"
  sound-feedback
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 600px; display: block;">

  <script type="text/three">
    const palette = [0x38bdf8, 0xf43f5e, 0x22c55e, 0xeab308, 0xa855f7];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const ball = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 24, 24),
        new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: palette[i % palette.length],
          metalness: 0.2,
          roughness: 0.25
        })
      );
      ball.name = `ball-${i}`;
      ball.position.set((i % 4 - 1.5) * 0.22, 1.3 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 0.22, -1.1);
      ball.userData.xr = {
        grab: '1-hand',
        physics: 'dynamic',
        restitution: 0.78
      };
      scene.add(ball);
    }

    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0);
    light.position.set(1, 3, 2);
    scene.add(light);
  </script>

  <div slot="spatial" data-position="0.55 1.25 -1.1" data-xr-traits="grab billboard">
    <div style="padding: 16px; background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; border-radius: 14px; width: 220px;">
      <h4 style="margin: 0 0 8px;">Physics Controls</h4>
      <p style="margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13px;">Grab spheres or bounce them off real-world surfaces.</p>
      <button onclick="document.querySelector('xr-live').transitionToVR({ durationMs: 400 })">
        Toggle VR Environment
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</xr-live>
```

## Recipe 3: Precision Manipulation Handles, Lazy Head-Follow HUD & Orbiting Satellites

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/xr-live-full.min.js"></script>

<xr-live
  allow-client-scripts
  xr-simulator="office"
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 560px; display: block;">

  <script type="text/three">
    // Centerpiece with 4 corner scale handles + pedestal yaw rotation bar
    const sculpture = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.22, 0.07, 64, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x6366f1, metalness: 0.7, roughness: 0.2 })
    );
    sculpture.name = 'sculpture';
    sculpture.position.set(0, 0.9, -1.2);
    sculpture.userData.xr = {
      grab: '2-hand',
      handles: { rotateAxis: 'y', minScale: 0.4, maxScale: 2.5 }
    };
    scene.add(sculpture);

    // Satellite orbiting the named 'sculpture' node
    const orbiter = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.05, 24, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8, emissive: 0x0284c7 })
    );
    orbiter.name = 'orbiter';
    orbiter.userData.xr = {
      orbit: { target: 'sculpture', radius: 0.45, speed: 1.2, height: 0.08, faceCenter: true }
    };
    scene.add(orbiter);

    // Lazy head-follow status pill with 18-degree angular deadzone
    const hudPill = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28, 0.08, 0.02),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x0f172a, roughness: 0.4 })
    );
    hudPill.name = 'hud-pill';
    hudPill.userData.xr = {
      follow: {
        mode: 'head',
        lazy: true,
        distance: 1.1,
        deadzoneDeg: 18,
        stiffness: 6,
        height: -0.22,
        faceUser: true
      }
    };
    scene.add(hudPill);
  </script>
</xr-live>
```

## Recipe 4: Multimodal Gemini Live Assistant + Hold-to-Ask + World Understanding

```html
<script type="module">
  import '/dist/xr-live-full.min.js';
  import { connectGeminiLive } from '/dist/xr-live-plugins.min.js';

  const xr = document.getElementById('gemini-xr');

  xr.addEventListener('xr-transcription', (e) => {
    console.log(`[${e.detail.speaker}] ${e.detail.text}`);
  });

  xr.addEventListener('xr-object-detected', (e) => {
    console.log(`Located ${e.detail.label} at`, e.detail.position);
  });

  // Connect only after user gesture (never on page load):
  document.getElementById('connect-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    connectGeminiLive(xr, {
      url: 'wss://your-proxy.example.com/gemini-live',
      frameIntervalMs: 1000,
      streamAudio: true,
      playAudio: true,
      detectObjects: true
    });
  });
</script>

<button id="connect-btn">Start Gemini Live Session</button>

<xr-live
  id="gemini-xr"
  allow-client-scripts
  world-understanding="planes reticle"
  xr-depth="occlusion"
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 560px; display: block;">

    const artifact = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.18, 0.22, 0.4, 32),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf59e0b, metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.3 })
    );

      }
    };

  </script>
</xr-live>
```

## Recipe 5: 3D Spatial Paint, Depth Particles & Gaussian Splats


## Recipe 6: Native Android (Kotlin) & iOS/visionOS (Swift) Integration

### Android (Google Filament + Jetpack XR SceneCore)
```kotlin
import com.google.threelive.ThreeLiveRuntimeSession
import com.google.threelive.XRLiveSceneCoreHelper
import com.google.threelive.filament.ThreeLiveFilament

// 1. Install the Filament renderer once at startup
ThreeLiveFilament.install()

// 2. Compile procedural Three.js and step XR traits / handles / particles natively
val session = ThreeLiveRuntimeSession.fromScript(scriptSource)
session.stepFrame(dtSeconds = 1f / 60f)

// 3. Or attach traits directly to an Android XR SceneCore entity from GLB bytes
XRLiveSceneCoreHelper.attachTraitsFromGlb(xrSession, rootEntity, glbByteBuffer)
```

### iOS & visionOS (Apple RealityKit)
```swift
import ThreeLiveCompiler
import RealityKit

@MainActor
func mountSpatialScene(script: String, in arView: ARView) async throws {
    let entity = try await RealityKitHelper.loadEntity(from: script)
    XRLiveRealityKit.installTraits(on: entity, in: arView)
}
```

```html
    };
```

```html
    scene.add(new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.0));
  </script>
```

# Debugging, Sandboxing & CSP Guide (`<three-live>` & `<xr-live>`)

## 1. Why Nothing Renders (Top 4 Causes)

1. **Missing `allow-client-scripts` attribute:**
   - **Symptom:** `<three-live>` or `<xr-live>` with an inline `<script type="text/three">` stays blank and dispatches an `error` event with `CLIENT_SCRIPTS_DISABLED_ERROR`.
   - **Fix:** Add `allow-client-scripts` to the element (`<three-live allow-client-scripts ...>`) or set `ThreeLiveElement.allowClientScripts = true` before connecting.
2. **Bundler moved the Worker engine asset (`sandboxEngineSrc`):**
   - **Symptom:** When bundling with Vite, Webpack, or Rollup instead of loading `/dist/three-live.min.js` via `<script>`, the sandbox Worker cannot auto-detect the IIFE bundle URL and fails closed.
   - **Fix:** Explicitly point `ThreeLiveElement.sandboxEngineSrc` at the IIFE `.min.js` bundle:
     ```js
     import { ThreeLiveElement } from 'three-live';
     ThreeLiveElement.sandboxEngineSrc =
       new URL('three-live/dist/three-live.min.js', import.meta.url).href;
     ```
3. **Strict Host CSP (`require-trusted-types-for 'script'` or blocked `blob:` Workers):**
   - **Symptom:** The host page's Content Security Policy blocks Worker creation or script evaluation.
   - **Fix:** Set `sandbox="iframe"` on the element and configure `ThreeLiveElement.sandboxIframeSrc` to point at `three-live-sandbox.html`, which runs inside an opaque-origin `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">`.
4. **Calling `new THREE.GLTFLoader()` or `fetch()` inside `<script type="text/three">`:**
   - **Symptom:** External model does not appear because `fetch` and `XMLHttpRequest` are permanently revoked inside the sandbox Worker.
   - **Fix:** Use `<three-live src="/path/to/model.glb">` or `<xr-anchor src="/path/to/model.glb">`.

## 3. Enforced Sandbox Quotas

Every procedural compilation (`toCanvas3D()`, `toGLB()`, `toUSDZ()`) runs `SceneQuotaValidator` with these defaults:
- **Max Script Size:** `1,048,576` bytes (`1 MiB`)
- **Max Meshes:** `1,000`
- **Max Vertices:** `100,000`
- **Max Indices:** `300,000`
- **Max Textures:** `16` (max dimension `2048×2048`)
- **Execution Watchdog:** `3,000 ms` wall-clock timeout (`250 ms` CPU ceiling inside Rust Boa compiler)
- **Max Concurrent Sandbox Workers:** `32`

---

## 4. Network CSP & Plugin Security Quotas (`gemini-live`, `shared-room`, `persistent-anchors`)

- **Host `connect-src` for Live Relays:** The procedural `<script type="text/three">` Worker always runs with network access revoked (`connect-src 'none'`). Host-level plugins (`connectGeminiLive()` and `shared-room="wss://..."`) connect from the main thread and enforce `wss://` (or loopback `ws://localhost` / `ws://127.0.0.1` / `ws://[::1]`). If your page serves a strict Content Security Policy and uses remote WebSocket relays, allow your relay origin in `connect-src` (e.g. `connect-src 'self' wss://your-relay.example.com`). Same-origin `shared-room="room-id"` uses `BroadcastChannel` and needs no `connect-src` allowance.
- **Persistence & Co-Presence Caps:**
  - `persistent-anchors`: `MAX_PERSISTED_NODES = 128`, `MAX_HASH_BYTES = 8192` (`#xr-state` tokens larger than `8 KB` or containing prototype-pollution keys are rejected).
  - `shared-room`: `MAX_PEERS = 16`, `MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 16384` (`16 KB`), `MAX_REMOTE_STROKES = 64`, `POSE_TICK_INTERVAL_MS = 50` (`20 Hz`), `SOFT_LOCK_TTL_MS = 2000`.

SOURCE: docs/three-live.md
================================================================================

# `<three-live>` Reference Guide

`<three-live>` is a lightweight WebGL2 3D viewer, procedural Three.js JIT
compiler, and `<model-viewer>` drop-in replacement with universal Augmented
Reality handoff (iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, and WebXR).

For interactive 6DoF WebXR spatial computing, declarative spatial traits
(`grab`, `scale`, `billboard`, `anchor`), spatial HTML cards (`<div
slot="spatial">`), depth/physics, and 25-joint hand tracking, see
**[`docs/xr-live.md`](xr-live.md)**. See **[`README.md`](../README.md)** for JS
bundles and entry points.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Quickstart

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live.min.js"></script>

<three-live
  src="/models/chair.glb"
  poster="/images/chair_poster.webp"
  camera-controls
  camera-orbit="30deg 20deg 3m"
  selected-mesh="cushion"
  ar
  ar-modes="quick-look scene-viewer webxr"
  auto-rotate
  style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
</three-live>

<script>
  const viewer = document.querySelector('three-live');

  // Listen for mesh part selection
  viewer.addEventListener('meshclick', (e) => {
    console.log('Selected part:', e.detail.meshName);
  });

  // Reset camera view
  viewer.resetCamera();
</script>
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Observed Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Bundle | Description |
| :--------------------- | :--------- | :------------------- | :------------------ |
| `src` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | URL or path to binary `.glb` model. |
| `ios-src` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Optional URL or path to Apple `.usdz` model for iOS Quick Look (auto-transcoded from GLB if omitted). |
| `poster` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | URL to a placeholder image shown before 3D rendering initializes. |
| `scale` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Uniform or per-axis scale multiplier `"x y z"` (e.g. `"2 2 2"`). |
| `camera-orbit` | `string` (str/JSON) | `three-live-viewer`+ | Initial camera orbit angles and distance\ 20deg 3m"` or `{"theta"\ "phi"\ "zoom"\ |
| `camera-target` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Orbit center coordinate `"x y z"` (e.g. `"0m 1.5m 0m"`, defaults to model bounding center). |
| `min-camera-orbit` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Lower bounds for camera orbit\ `"theta phi radius"` (e.g. `"-45deg 0deg 1m"` or `"auto 0deg auto"`). |
| `max-camera-orbit` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Upper bounds for camera orbit (e.g. `"auto 90deg auto"` prevents orbiting beneath the ground plane). |
| `field-of-view` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Vertical field of view angle (e.g. `"45deg"`, clamps between `10deg` and `90deg`). |
| `selected-mesh` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Name of the sub-mesh to highlight. |
| `camera-controls` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Enables interactive orbit/pan/zoom camera controls (disabled by default unless `camera-controls` is present, matching `<model-viewer>`). |
| `ar` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Enables the augmented reality launcher button. |
| `ar-modes` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Space-delimited AR modes\ `quick-look`, `scene-viewer`, `webxr`. |
| `ar-scale` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Controls whether the model can be scaled in AR\ `"auto"` (default) or `"fixed"`. |
| `ar-placement` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Controls AR surface placement mode\ `"floor"` (default) or `"wall"`. |
| `script-src` | `string` | `three-live`+ | URL or path to a server-generated procedural Three.js scene script. |
| `sandbox` | `string` | `three-live`+ | Mandatory sandbox mode (`"worker"` or `"iframe"`). Default\ `"worker"`. |
| `allow-client-scripts` | `boolean` | `three-live`+ | Explicit opt-in allowing client-modified script strings via `executeScript()` or inline `<script>`. |
| `exposure` | `number` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Exposure / lighting multiplier for ambient/environment light intensity (default\ |
| `environment-image` | `string` | `three-live-extras` | Equirectangular `.hdr`/`.pic` radiance map or LDR environment image for ambient reflections and SH irradiance. |
| `skybox-image` | `string` | `three-live-extras` | Visible background equirectangular skybox image URL rendered behind the 3D scene. |
| `shadow-intensity` | `number` | `three-live-extras` | Ground contact shadow opacity from `0.0` (off) to `1.0` (default\ `0.7`). |
| `shadow-softness` | `number` | `three-live-extras` | Radial Gaussian blur falloff of contact shadow from `0.0` (hard) to `1.0` (soft). |
| `tone-mapping` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Tone mapping mode: `"neutral"` (default, Khronos PBR Neutral for commerce), `"reinhard"`, or `"none"`. |
| `autoplay` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Automatically starts keyframe animation playback on model load. |
| `animation-name` | `string` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Name of specific glTF animation clip to play (defaults to first clip). |
| `auto-rotate` | `boolean` | `three-live-viewer`+ | Automatically rotates the camera around the model. |

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## `<model-viewer>` Drop-in Imperative API

`<three-live>` provides full drop-in compatibility for `<model-viewer>`
JavaScript configurators, hotspot managers, and AR launchers:

-   **Camera & Screenshot:** `viewer.getCameraOrbit()`,
    `viewer.getCameraTarget()`, `viewer.getFieldOfView()`,
    `viewer.jumpCameraToGoal()`, `viewer.toDataURL()`, `await viewer.toBlob()`
-   **AR Status & Activation:** `viewer.canActivateAR` (boolean getter), `await
    viewer.activateAR()`
-   **Surface Raycasting:** `viewer.positionAndNormalFromPoint(pixelX, pixelY)`
    returns `{ position: { x, y, z, toString() }, normal: { x, y, z, toString()
    } } | null`
-   **Live Material Editing (`viewer.model.materials`):**

    ```js
    const mat = viewer.model.getMaterialByName('Leather') || viewer.model.materials[0];
    mat.pbrMetallicRoughness.setBaseColorFactor([0.8, 0.2, 0.1, 1.0]);
    mat.pbrMetallicRoughness.setRoughnessFactor(0.35);
    ```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## DOM Events

| Event | Detail Payload | Description |
| :-------------- | :------------------------- | :---------------------------- |
| `load` | `{ model: GLBData }` | Fired when the 3D model or procedural scene finishes loading. |
| `error` | `{ error: Error }` | Fired if model loading or script execution fails. |
| `camera-change` | `{ theta, phi, distance }` | Fired whenever the camera orbit changes. |
| `ar-status` | `{ status: 'session-started' \ | 'not-presenting' \ | 'failed', error? }` | Fired when AR session status transitions (`<model-viewer>` standard). |
| `meshclick` | `{ meshName, hitPoint, normal, distance }` | Fired when a user clicks or taps a sub-mesh. |

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Custom AR Button Overlay (`slot="ar-button"` / `activateAR()`)

Provide a child element with `slot="ar-button"` to replace the default AR button
overlay with your own custom styled button. `<three-live>` automatically hides
its built-in button, manages visibility when `ar` is enabled, and triggers
`activateAR()` on click:

```html
<three-live src="/models/chair.glb" camera-controls ar style="width: 100%; height: 500px;">
  <button slot="ar-button" class="custom-ar-btn">
    ✨ View in Your Space
  </button>
</three-live>
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Visual Extensions & Plugins

### 3D Hotspots & Annotations (`three-live/extras`)

Import `three-live/extras` (or use `three-live-full.min.js`) to attach
interactive HTML buttons or callouts pinned to 3D surface coordinates. Hotspots
automatically orbit with the camera and support surface normal occlusion
culling:

```html
<script type="module" src="/dist/three-live-full.min.js"></script>

<three-live src="/models/astronaut.glb" camera-controls camera-target="0 1.2 0" style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
  <button slot="hotspot-visor" data-position="0 1.5 0.3" data-normal="0 0 1" class="hotspot">
    Gold-coated Visor
  </button>
  <div slot="hotspot-pack" data-position="0 1.3 -0.4" data-normal="0 0 -1" class="hotspot">
    Life Support Unit
  </div>
</three-live>
```

Update a hotspot dynamically at runtime using `viewer.updateHotspot({ name,
position, normal })`.

### PBR Rendering & Lighting Extensions

-   **Core WebGL2 PBR (`three-live-viewer`+):**
    -   **Screen-Space Derivative Normal Maps:** Perturbs normals via GLSL
        `dFdx`/`dFdy` without requiring glTF vertex tangents.
    -   **Khronos PBR Neutral Tone Mapping:** Accurate color fidelity for
        e-commerce products without chalky highlight desaturation.
-   **PBR Next Materials, HDRI & Contact Shadows (`three-live/extras`):**
    -   **glTF PBR Next Extensions:** Shader support for Clearcoat
        (`KHR_materials_clearcoat`), Transmission
        (`KHR_materials_transmission`), Dispersion (`KHR_materials_dispersion`),
        Volume Attenuation (`KHR_materials_volume`), Iridescence
        (`KHR_materials_iridescence`), and Sheen (`KHR_materials_sheen`).
    -   **HDRI Radiance Maps & Spherical Harmonics:** Set
        `environment-image="/env/studio.hdr"` to parse Radiance `.hdr` RGBE
        textures, prefilter GGX specular mipmaps, and project 9-coefficient
        Spherical Harmonics diffuse irradiance.
    -   **Analytical Ground Contact Shadows:** Set `shadow-intensity="0.7"` and
        `shadow-softness="0.5"` for soft ground ambient occlusion without shadow
        map pass overhead.

### Animations: Rigid-Body TRS & Skeletal/Morph Plugins

-   **Rigid-Body Keyframe Animations (`three-live-viewer`+):** Node translation,
    rotation, and scale (`TRS`) keyframe tracks are built into all bundles
    (`el.availableAnimations`, `el.play()`, `el.pause()`).
-   **GPU Skeletal Skinning, Morph Targets & Cross-Fading
    (`three-live/animation`):** Import `three-live/animation` (or use
    `three-live-full.min.js`) to enable 64-joint GPU vertex skinning
    (`JOINTS_0`/`WEIGHTS_0`), morph target blending (`weights`), and smooth clip
    cross-fading (`el.crossFadeTo('Walk', 0.3)`).

### Declarative `KHR_interactivity` Behavior Graphs (`userData.interactivity`)

Inside `<script type="text/three">`, any `THREE.Mesh` or `THREE.Group` can attach
declarative `userData.interactivity` triggers (`onSelect`, `onHoverIn`,
`onHoverOut`, `onStart`, `onReceive`) that compile into standard Khronos
`KHR_interactivity` bytecode embedded inside exported `.glb` files and executed
by the `three-live/extras` VM on Web, Android, and iOS:

```html
<three-live allow-client-scripts camera-controls style="width: 100%; height: 480px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const button = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.8, 0.3, 0.8),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x38bdf8, metalness: 0.4, roughness: 0.3 })
    );
    button.name = ' interactive-box';
    button.userData.interactivity = {
      onSelect: [
        {
          action: 'toggleTransform',
          property: 'translation',
          from: [0, 0, 0],
          to: [0, 0.4, 0],
          duration: 0.35
        },
        {
          action: 'cycleMaterialColor',
          colors: [
            [0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 1.0],
            [0.13, 0.77, 0.37, 1.0],
            [0.96, 0.25, 0.37, 1.0]
          ],
          duration: 0.25
        }
      ]
    };
    scene.add(button);
  </script>
</three-live>
```

Supported action objects in `onSelect` / `onHoverIn` / `onHoverOut` / `onStart` / `onReceive[eventName]`:
- `toggleTransform`: `{ action: 'toggleTransform', property: 'translation' | 'rotation' | 'scale', from?: number[], to: number[], duration?: number }`
- `interpolate`: `{ action: 'interpolate', target?: string, property: 'translation' | 'rotation' | 'scale' | 'baseColorFactor' | 'metallicFactor' | 'roughnessFactor' | 'emissiveFactor', to: number | number[], duration?: number }`
- `setProperty`: `{ action: 'setProperty', target?: string, property: string, value: unknown }`
- `toggleVisibility`: `{ action: 'toggleVisibility', target?: string }`
- `cycleMaterialColor`: `{ action: 'cycleMaterialColor', colors: Array<[number, number, number, number?]>, duration?: number }`
- `playAnimation` / `stopAnimation`: `{ action: 'playAnimation', animation?: number }` / `{ action: 'stopAnimation' }`
- `sendEvent`: `{ action: 'sendEvent', event: string, values?: Record<string, unknown> }` (dispatches `interactivityEvent` on the host element).

### Pluggable Mesh & Texture Decoders

Heavy decompression runtimes (Draco WASM, Meshopt, KTX2) are not bundled by
default. Register external decoders on demand:

```javascript
import { ThreeLiveElement } from 'three-live';

ThreeLiveElement.registerDecoder('draco', myDracoDecoder);
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Procedural Scene Scripting (`three-author`)

`<three-live>` supports two procedural scene compilation workflows:

1.  **Server-Generated Scene Scripts (Default — `script-src` /
    `loadScriptFromSrc(url)`):** The client passes a script URL directly to the
    sandbox (`<three-live script-src="https://.../scene.js">`). The sandbox
    Worker loads and compiles the script directly via `importScripts` without
    requiring `'unsafe-eval'` or `new Function()`.
2.  **Client-Modified Scene Scripts (Opt-In — `allow-client-scripts` /
    `ThreeLiveElement.allowClientScripts = true`):** For interactive code
    editors or client-modified scripts (`el.executeScript(code)` or inline
    `<script type="text/three">`), explicitly opt in via the
    `allow-client-scripts` attribute or `ThreeLiveElement.allowClientScripts =
    true`:

```html
<three-live
  allow-client-scripts
  camera-controls
  style="width: 100%; height: 500px; display: block;">
  <script type="text/three">
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x4285f4 });
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    scene.add(mesh);
  </script>
</three-live>
```

### Security & Sandboxing Architecture

Three-Live operates under a **fail-closed** security model for untrusted or
AI-generated script execution:

-   **Isolated Web Worker (default, `sandbox="worker"`):** Scripts run in a
    dedicated Worker with no DOM access. Before any author code runs, the worker
    revokes its own ambient authority — `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`,
    `EventSource`, `importScripts`, `navigator` (and therefore `sendBeacon`),
    `indexedDB`, `caches`, `Worker`, `SharedWorker`, `BroadcastChannel`,
    `SharedArrayBuffer` and `Atomics` are all made permanently `undefined`. The
    channel back to the host is captured in a closure and `self.postMessage` is
    replaced with a throwing stub, so a script cannot forge a result message.
-   **Execution watchdog:** A script that exceeds
    `SECURITY_3D_SANDBOX_TIMEOUT_MS` (3 s) has its worker terminated and raises
    an `error` event. At most `SECURITY_3D_MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS` (32) sandbox
    workers may be alive at once.
-   **Quota enforcement:** `Scene.toCanvas3D()`, `toGLB()` and `toUSDZ()` all
    run `SceneQuotaValidator`, so no serialization path can skip the vertex,
    index, mesh and texture ceilings. Scripts larger than
    `SECURITY_3D_MAX_SCRIPT_BYTES` (1 MiB) are rejected before execution.
-   **Fail-Closed Guarantee & Mandatory Sandboxing:** Sandboxing is strictly
    required for all live procedural compilation and cannot be bypassed.
    `sandbox="none"` and `sandbox="unsafe-host-realm"` are prohibited and
    rejected with a `SecurityError`. If Web Workers or the sandbox iframe are
    unavailable or blocked by Content Security Policy (CSP), Three-Live **fails
    closed**: it halts execution, emits an `error` event, and throws rather than
    evaluating code in the host realm.
-   **Opaque-Origin Iframe + Worker Isolation (`sandbox="iframe"`):** For hosts
    enforcing strict CSP (`require-trusted-types-for 'script'`, no
    `'unsafe-eval'` on the host document), set `sandbox="iframe"` or configure
    `ThreeLiveElement.sandboxIframeSrc` to point at `three-live-sandbox.html`.
    Three-Live mounts a hidden `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">` (omitting
    `allow-same-origin` so the iframe and its Worker run in a unique `null`
    opaque origin) with its own `connect-src 'none'` CSP, completely isolating
    script evaluation from the host page's origin, cookies, storage, and CSP.

#### Pointing the sandbox at the engine

The worker loads the Three-Live runtime by URL. When the library is included via
a classic `<script src="three-live.min.js">` tag this is auto-detected. If you
bundle Three-Live with webpack, Vite or Rollup, set it explicitly:

```js
import {ThreeLiveElement} from 'three-live';

ThreeLiveElement.sandboxEngineSrc =
    new URL('three-live/dist/three-live.min.js', import.meta.url).href;

// Optional: enable opaque-origin <iframe sandbox="allow-scripts"> isolation
// across all <three-live> elements on strict-CSP pages:
ThreeLiveElement.sandboxIframeSrc =
    new URL('three-live/dist/three-live-sandbox.html', import.meta.url).href;
```

The URL must point at an **IIFE** build (`*.min.js`), be same-origin or
CORS-enabled, and be permitted by your CSP `script-src`. If it cannot be
resolved, sandboxed execution fails closed rather than falling back to the host
realm. This mirrors how Monaco, PDF.js and Tesseract.js require their worker
assets to be located.

### Supported Procedural Scripting Subset

-   **Math & Core:** `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Euler`, `Quaternion`,
    `Matrix3`, `Matrix4`, `Color`, `MathUtils`, `Clock`.
-   **Primitives & Geometries:** `BoxGeometry`, `PlaneGeometry`,
    `SphereGeometry`, `CylinderGeometry`, `ConeGeometry`, `TorusGeometry`,
    `TorusKnotGeometry`, `BufferGeometry`, `BufferAttribute`.
-   **Materials:** `MeshStandardMaterial`, `MeshBasicMaterial`,
    `MeshLambertMaterial`, `MeshPhongMaterial`, `MeshPhysicalMaterial` (mapped
    to glTF PBR metallic-roughness properties).
-   **Scene Graph:** `Scene`, `Group`, `Mesh`, `Object3D` (`position`,
    `rotation`, `scale`, `matrix`, `add`, `remove`, `traverse`).
-   **Lights & Cameras:** `AmbientLight`, `DirectionalLight`, `PointLight`,
    `Camera`, `PerspectiveCamera`.
-   **Permissive LLM Fallbacks & Warnings:** Unsupported Three.js shaders
    (`ShaderMaterial`, `RawShaderMaterial`), polyhedra/extended geometries
    (`IcosahedronGeometry`, `OctahedronGeometry`, `CapsuleGeometry`,
    `RingGeometry`, `CircleGeometry`), lights (`SpotLight`, `HemisphereLight`,
    `RectAreaLight`), and headless browser globals (`requestAnimationFrame`,
    `window`, `document`) gracefully degrade to standard PBR/primitive
    equivalents without crashing the 3D/XR scene. All fallback events emit a
    deduplicated warning and can be inspected via `THREE.getAuthorWarnings()`.
-   **Scene Quotas:** Max **1,000 meshes**, **100,000 vertices**, **300,000
    indices**, **16 textures** (max 2048×2048), and a **5-second** wall-clock
    execution watchdog.
